items.notes: Missing core claim: ranking and provenance are separate, so a well-scored hit or cached snippet must be bound to the index generation and source revision that produced it.
Missing core claim: session tokens are partition-bound, so a token cannot order reads that land on another partition.

Missing core claim: overlap can still return a stale value after a failed write, sloppy membership or a selector that ignores the newest replica, and sloppy quorum trades that overlap for availability.
No core claim missing: the one-way rule, link fields, derived-index provenance, non-promotion and validator limits are all covered.
No core claim missing: one-way linking, backlink harm, link fields, reverse-index provenance and the limits on what a link establishes are covered.
